---
title: 출석수업 과제물
---

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}
# 202535-368231
set.seed(8231)

roll_die <- function(count) {
  die <- floor(6 * runif(count) + 1) |> as.integer()

  freq <- tibble(die = die) |>
    count(.data[["die"]]) |>
    mutate(n_rel = map_dbl(n, ~ .x / count))

  ggplot(freq, aes(.data[["die"]], .data[["n_rel"]])) +
    geom_col(fill = "skyblue", color = "gray") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 7, by = 1)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1 / 6, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = paste("n = ", count)) +
    theme_minimal()
}

c(10, 100, 1000, 10000) |>
  map(roll_die) |>
  wrap_plots(ncol = 2)
```
